# Joe's Vintage Guitars

> Joe's Vintage Guitars is a by-appointment vintage guitar buyer and shop in Mesa, Arizona (Phoenix area), specializing in buying, selling, consigning, and appraising vintage electric and acoustic guitars, basses, and amps. Owner Joe is a longtime vintage-instrument specialist with a 4.9-star Reverb shop (joe-s-gear-emporium-4, 2,191 verified reviews).

## Serial Number Lookup and Dating Guides

- [Gibson Serial Number Lookup and Dating Guide](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/how-to-read-gibson-serial-numbers/): Free decoder plus full dating charts for Gibson serial numbers by era.
- [Fender Serial Number Guide](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/fender-guitars-serial-number-guide/): How to find and decode Fender serial numbers, with a decoder tool.
  - [Fender Pot Codes](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/fender-pot-codes/): Date a Fender to the week from the maker and date code stamped on its potentiometers.
  - [Fender Neck Date Codes](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/fender-neck-dates/): Read the penciled or stamped date on a Fender neck heel.
  - [Fender Body Date Codes](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/fender-body-dates/): Find and read the date marked in a Fender body cavity or neck pocket.
  - [Fender Pickup Date Codes](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/fender-pickup-dates/): Date the pickups on a vintage Fender from the codes on the pickup base.
  - [Fender Dating by Physical Features](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/fender-physical-features/): Date a Fender by its logo, pickguard, saddles, tuners, and fretboard inlays.
  - [How to Date a Fender Stratocaster](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/fender-stratocaster-dating-guide/): What changed on the Stratocaster each year from 1954 to 1971, and the fastest way to see it.
  - [How to Date a Fender Telecaster](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/fender-telecaster-dating-guide/): Blackguard to whiteguard, the four name changes, and the Telecaster year by year.
  - [How to Date a Fender Jazzmaster](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/fender-jazzmaster-dating-guide/): All four pickguard combinations including the gold anodized guard, year by year from 1958 to 1971.
  - [How to Date a Fender Jaguar](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/fender-jaguar-dating-guide/): The Jaguar year by year from 1962 to 1975, why the headstock logo will not date it, and what the patent block does instead.
  - [How to Date a Fender Jazz Bass](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/fender-jazz-bass-dating-guide/): The Jazz Bass year by year from 1960 to 1975, the stack knob years, and the 1970s bridge pickup move.
  - [How to Date a Fender Precision Bass](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/fender-precision-bass-dating-guide/): The Precision Bass year by year from 1951 to 1975, the slab and gold guard eras, and what the model never got.
- [Martin Serial Number Lookup](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/martin-serial-and-model-numbers/): Date any Martin from 1898 to today with full serial charts by era.
- [Guild Serial Number Lookup and Chart](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/guild-serial-number-lookup/): Decode Guild serial numbers and date your Guild guitar.
- [Gretsch Serial Number Lookup](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/gretsch-serial-number-lookup/): Find and decode Gretsch serial numbers.
- [Rickenbacker Serial Numbers](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/rickenbacker-serial-numbers/): How to read and date Rickenbacker serial numbers.
- [Fender Amplifier Serial Numbers](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/vintage-fender-amplifier-serial-numbers-how-to-find-the-year/): How to find the year of a vintage Fender amp.

## Vintage Value Guides

- [Vintage Gibson Les Paul Value Guide](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/vintage-gibson-les-paul-market-value-guide/): What a vintage Les Paul is worth, with price ranges by year.
- [Vintage Fender Stratocaster Value Guide](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/vintage-fender-stratocaster-value-guide/): 1954 to 1965 Stratocaster values by year and finish.
- [Vintage Fender Telecaster Value Guide](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/vintage-fender-telecaster-value-guide/): Vintage Telecaster price ranges by era.
- [Vintage Martin D-28, D-18, D-45 Value Guide](https://www.joesvintageguitarsaz.com/martin-d-28-d-18-d-45-dreadnought-value-guide/): Pre-war to 1969 Martin dreadnought values by model and era.
